title: DECISION: NUL byte explicitly rejected in Message-ID
description: validation.rs's is_valid_message_id() includes an explicit NUL (\0) check alongside the is_whitespace() check, with a comment explaining that NUL is not matched by Rust's is_whitespace(). RFC 5322 §2.2 forbids NUL in header field values, and NUL in a message-id used as a map key or canonical-serialisation component would corrupt downstream storage. The test test_nul_byte_rejected_in_message_id() verifies both local-part and domain-part injection. This is a subtle correctness point that is easy to miss.
